result.reason: The clause appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes revocation at Vendor’s sole discretion. However, it does not expressly make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. Successor transferability also depends entirely on unseen Section 13.3, so compliance cannot be confirmed. Adding “suspendable” is unnecessary under the stated playbook and may introduce a remedy not present in the original clause. The drafting is otherwise clear, but the margin comment overstates alignment with the full playbook position.
